name: Shadowless
storyline: This house is marked by a terrible past. Families have been murdered, people have gone mad, many have committed suicide and other horrific events have occurred. Each room has its own story painted on an invisible canvas. As a player, you will experience parts of this dark past and every shred of it will leave you unsettled and horrified. Soon you will wish you could join the ranks of the dead in their abyss, but death will not help you leave this place. Will you run from it, or will you try to uncover the truth that lies behind the shadows?
summary: Shadowless is a first-person psychological horror game. Explore a creepy house marked by tragedy, where dark entities and the past haunt you. Defenseless, you face a nightmare that consumes you before you can escape.
